template.name: Volume Climax Reversal
template.entry_long: rsi(close,{p0}) < {p0} and volume_ratio(volume,{p1}) > {p1} and close > donchian_low_prev(low,{p2})
template.notes: Climax-volume bar with oversold conditions then close ticking back above prior-bar low approximates 'large volume bar closes and price begins to retrace' (corpus has no ref()/LR; RSI/donchian used as conservative stand-ins). Exit when retrace momentum fades below RSI 40. StopLoss=2% documented.
